---
title: "2 eDNA PCR"
---

**Polymerase:** Phusion™ Hot Start Flex 2X Master Mix (NEB M0536)  
**Purpose:** amplify short mitochondrial markers suitable for potentially fragmented environmental DNA.

## Primer systems

| eDNA PCR | Target | Forward primer | Reverse primer | Expected product | Calculated starting Ta* |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| eDNA 1 | 16S marine vertebrates | MarVer3F `AGACGAGAAGACCCTRTG` | MarVer3R `GGATTGCGCTGTTATCCC` | ~245 bp average | **58–61 °C** |
| eDNA 2 | NADH2 sharks | ChimeraF `AAGGACTACTTTGATAGAGT` | miniSharkR5 `CCTATTCAAACTAGGAGTC` | ~320 bp | **55 °C** |
| eDNA 3 | NADH2 sharks + rays | ChimeraF `AAGGACTACTTTGATAGAGT` | miniSharkR2 `GGAATRATGGCTAATGTGTT` | ~320 bp | **56 °C** |

*Calculated starting values assume Phusion Hot Start Flex 2X Master Mix and 0.5 µM of each primer. Degenerate bases create more than one possible oligonucleotide sequence; therefore a range is shown for MarVer3.
